summary.answer: The added connection is a conditional sampled-health contract. Once the saved tick's earlier gates pass, health lower than old_health records the current polling time in var_ba47a7a3 and skips heal for that call; equal or higher health goes to heal instead (healthoverlay.gsc:625-690,704). Damage table callbacks, laststand_damage notify, local health++ and the later finishplayerdamage boundary are separate channels, so a damage notification does not by itself establish this timestamp or net health loss (player_damage.gsc:132-156,625-644). Downed/remote-control gates normally leave the old sample and delay marker untouched; full-health return refreshes old_health, while a lower-cap return writes health without refreshing old_health (healthoverlay.gsc:340-360,565-583,646-668). After revive clears laststand, the next eligible call can therefore see restored health against an older pre-down sample unless the owning lifecycle route has replaced the table; revive does not itself reset these fields in its cited transition (laststand_warzone.gsc:2007-2056; healthoverlay.gsc:605-619,675-704). For positive regen_delay, exact elapsed==delay passes the time gate, but positive delay and health below var_66cb03ad are still required. ignore_health_regen_delay skips only the elapsed comparison; disable_health_regen_delay writes marker=1, which is not an unconditional bypass for every clock/delay pair (healthoverlay.gsc:366-389). These are recovered-source conditions, not PS4 outcomes, event ordering, an effective HMH setting or a new whole-body reconstruction.

summary.answer: The missing connection is a shared level pump with finite per-player state initialization. healthoverlay registers its preinit, chooses a model-specific spawn/restart target, then launches the pump in both branches. New-model initialization arms and replaces the player state; selected visits require a defined table and run the existing gated tick, then stamp the visit time after any normal tick return. Player stop events disarm without clearing the table or killing the level pump. T7 retains its separate entity loop and end_healthregen channel. Downed/revived state can pause/resume eligibility without a new initialization; a fresh delivered spawn or explicit restart replaces it. The server-level game_ended notify is the loop cancellation channel, separate from table callbacks, native matchflag and clientfields. Exact HMH effective model, build binding, VM scheduling/native clocks and event delivery remain unproved. The pump has no saved prior full-body contract, so this is a narrow source-only dependency answer with zero function-completion credit.

summary.answer: Connected enable_healing to the conditional self-owned inventory hook and its asynchronous slot10 debit. The hook captures the current network ID, not the activation weapon. Count1→0 can schedule deferred removal; count0 underflows to a clamped0 and exits before that removal. The passed third0 does not suppress the use body. Health mutation and completion occur through separate admitted paths, so item spending is not proof of health gained. Narrow slot/weapon mutation edges are cited with helper/native limits; all claims remain source-only drafts.
